title: RNA Electrophoresis in Agarose Gels
author: Jonathan Houseley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bnsxmefn

steps.title: Prepare Glyoxal/EtBr Mix
steps.instruction: Add ethidium bromide to an aliquot of glyoxal mix to reach a final concentration of 20 µg/mL.

steps.title: Denature RNA Samples
steps.instruction: Mix RNA samples with the glyoxal/EtBr mix and incubate at 55 °C for 1 hour.

substeps.instruction: Mix 15 µL glyoxal/EtBr with 3 µL RNA sample (or less RNA sample).
Ensure the ratio of glyoxal mix to RNA is at least 5:1.
Incubate at 55 °C for 01:00:00 (can be longer if the gel is not ready).
Do not let samples sit at room temperature to avoid compromising migration.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Ladder
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA ladder for denaturation and incubation.

substeps.instruction: Mix 3 µL DNA ladder with 15 µL glyoxal mix.
Add 0.3 µL of 10 mg/mL ethidium bromide.
Incubate at 55 °C along with the RNA samples.
Mix 1.8 g agarose with 150 mL 1× BPTE.
Ensure agarose is fully melted to avoid lumps that impair transfer.

steps.title: Load and Run Gel
steps.instruction: Load the samples and perform electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples briefly and load onto the gel.
Optional: Add 5 µL bromophenol blue loading dye to a spare lane to track migration.
Run the gel at 150 V (maximum 6 V/cm based on electrode distance) until bromophenol blue is ~2 cm from the bottom (approximately 01:30:00).

steps.title: Image the Gel
steps.instruction: Acquire a digital image of the ethidium staining pattern using a trans-illuminator or fluorescence imager for quantification and molecular weight assessment.

steps.title: Wash Gel with NaOH
steps.instruction: Wash the gel with 75 mM NaOH for 20 minutes to break RNA into appropriate size fragments for transfer and hybridization.

steps.title: Rinse Gel
steps.instruction: Rinse the gel with milliQ water.

steps.title: Neutralize Gel
steps.instruction: Perform two neutralization washes on a shaker.

substeps.instruction: Wash once with neutralization solution for 20 minutes (can be extended up to 1.5 h).
Wash a second time with neutralization solution for 20 minutes (can be extended up to 1.5 h).
